method: A true HEAD tree was materialised with `git archive HEAD tools/haider | tar -x` and the same admission resolution run against both trees in separate processes.
delta: None in behaviour. Admitted concurrency, topology and per-slot usable context are identical; only the PROVENANCE changed, from a hardcoded literal to the authority's fallback rung. Supplying demand_tokens is what raises the allocation, and nothing does that implicitly.
tests_corrected_not_weakened: hcli_scheduler_test.py and hcli_dag_consolidation_test.py called Scheduler.complete without a verifier outcome, which the new gate refuses. They now supply a passing outcome (PASSING_VERIFICATION) because they test scheduling and durability, not verifier bypass. hcli_dag_consolidation_test check 6 expected a hand-marked VERIFIED to survive reload; it now expects STALE plus an unchanged file and is_goal_met() False, which is strictly stronger.
